name: Vet CBD Dogs & Cats CBD:THC Drops | Unflavored 20:1
description:
Veterinarian-formulated. Pet-tested. Purpose-driven.
For over a decade, California pet parents have trusted our flagship CBD:THC ratio tinctures to help their pets live calmer, more comfortable, and more balanced lives. Now, under the 2018 Farm Bill, we’re bringing the same beloved formula nationwide. Crafted by a veterinarian with over 10 years of cannabinoid therapy experience, VetCBD Advanced combines premium full-spectrum hemp extract with extra virgin olive oil for safe, effective, and holistic support. Gentle yet powerful, this daily wellness tincture helps maintain calm without sedation, supports joint mobility, promotes normal brain function, and aids digestive health — making it a simple, trusted choice for pets of all ages.
